fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.description: A short label above the heading. Drawn as a paragraph, never a heading.

fields.name: plans
fields.label: Plans
fields.description: One plan reads on its own, two sit side by side, three or more cap at three across.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The plan's heading, and its button's text when the button has none.

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price
fields.description: Written as it should read, such as £29, From £750 or POA.

fields.name: period
fields.label: Period
fields.description: What the price is per, such as a month or one-off. Read straight after the price.

fields.name: included
fields.label: Included in this plan
fields.description: Untick to show something the plan does not include. It is drawn crossed out and read as "Not included".
